storyCards.fact:
Josh Turner's "Time Is Love" reached #44 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Time Is Love" is a song written by Tony Martin, Mark Nesler and Tom Shapiro and recorded by American country music artist Josh Turner.

The song peaked at #44 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 25 weeks on the chart.

Time Is Love was released in 2012.
